title: File sync and storage
summary: Keep users' files in sync across devices and store them durably.
functional: Upload, download and sync files across devices
non_functional: A change reaches other online devices within seconds

daily_active_users.why: A fifth of users sync on a given day.

stored_bytes_per_user.why: Average 2 GB per user, most free-tier accounts holding little.

dedupe_savings.why: Identical blocks across users (installers, shared documents).

erasure_overhead.why: Erasure coding instead of three full copies.

changes_per_user_per_day.why: Files changed per active user per day.

metadata_ops_per_change.why: Block lookups, version writes and notifications per change.
